title: Article 386 — Council of Ministers for States in Part B (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 386 provided for the Council of Ministers for States in Part B of the First Schedule. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
content.glance: Art 386 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Part B Council of Ministers transitional — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 386?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
